Wellness Challenge

Join one of our YMCA Wellness Challenges that are designed to keep you motivated, active, and connected! Each challenge focuses on helping you build healthy habits, stay accountable, and have fun while working toward your wellness goals. Whether it’s moving more, eating better, or finding balance, there’s a challenge for everyone. Earn rewards, celebrate progress, and be part of a supportive community cheering you on every step of the way!


Planksgiving

Clarksville
11/1/26 - 11/30/26
VIEW

Planksgiving is a 30-day Fitness Challenge to help you build strength through the month of November. The goal is to complete each designated plank challenge or choose a modification that works best for you.

Join the challenge and pick up your calendar from the front desk or the digital version attached to your registration email.
